about.heading: About
about.intro: Born in 1995, Chiba, Japan. Founded AI TOKYO at 24, bringing a new paradigm to the beauty industry. Now leads P.B Group Holdings across salon, real estate, architecture, product, and AI ventures. Building toward a ¥10B enterprise.

items.text: Graduated Ebisu Beauty College, joined OCEAN TOKYO
Fastest stylist debut at OCEAN TOKYO (2 years), monthly avg. revenue over ¥4.6M
First-ever Director promotion at OCEAN TOKYO
Founded P.B Inc., opened AI TOKYO Shibuya flagship
Opened AI TOKYO Shibuya 3rd & Ikebukuro locations
Launched haircare brand 'AI me' on Makuake, 400% funded
Acquired 100% of unique Inc. (M&A), expanding P.B Group into construction
6 companies, 11 locations — building a ¥10B diversified enterprise group

salon.name: AITOKYO
salon.description: Hair salons across Tokyo, Yokohama & Nagoya. 8 direct, 2 brand-share, 1 eyelash-eyebrow — 11 total locations. 4.91 review rating, 73%+ repeat rate. Full-service salon brand for both men and women

brands.name: AI TOKYO -MEN-
brands.label: Men's Brand
brands.description: Men's specialist hair salon. Bone-structure corrective cuts, perms, and eyebrow grooming — designed to help men look their best. Expanding across Shibuya, Yokohama, and Nagoya

brands.name: AI TOKYO hair
brands.label: Ladies' Brand
brands.description: Trend-forward ladies' salon focused on reproducibility. Specializing in color, straightening, and hair quality improvement — proposing hair design that fits your lifestyle

brands.name: AITOKYO +
brands.label: Brand Share
brands.description: A new format sharing AITOKYO's brand power, customer acquisition, and training know-how with independent stylists and salon owners. Low-risk, high-quality expansion model

brands.name: ams by AI TOKYO
brands.label: Eyelash & Eyebrow
brands.description: Specialist salon for lash perms, extensions, and eyebrow styling. Leveraging AITOKYO's beauty expertise for total eye beauty

product.name: P.B Product
product.description: In-house haircare brand 'AI me' — planning, manufacturing & sales. Expanding lineup: shampoo, treatment, oil, wax. High-margin model, D2C (own EC) as the primary channel

realestate.name: P.B Real Estate
realestate.description: Full-service real estate covering stores, offices, and residential properties. Brokerage as core, expanding into sublease, sales, and property management. Handling diverse property types across F&B, retail, office, and more — aiming to build developer capabilities

architecture.name: unique
architecture.description: Full-service construction: new builds, large-scale renovation, interior design, and construction management. Covering salons, F&B, retail, offices, and residential with strengths in design, speed, and flexibility. A key profit pillar of the group

ai.name: aisalon
ai.description: AI-powered salon digital transformation. Industry-leading IT adoption and DX, enabling systematized and efficient salon operations

advisory.name: Advisory
advisory.description: Online academy for salon owners and Kamagata's personal advisory. End-to-end support from management training to solving business challenges

philosophy.heading: Philosophy
philosophy.mission: Realize the ideals of everyone we touch.
philosophy.vision: Change the world through human potential.
philosophy.creed: Lead customers, employees, and society to happiness.

recruit.heading: Recruit
recruit.title: Join us — we are looking for teammates
recruit.description: P.B Group Holdings is hiring across all divisions: hairdressers, assistants, reception, construction managers, real estate sales, back-office, general affairs, marketers, engineers, and more.
